coverage_notes: Natural Earth 50m is generalized source geography, not an exhaustive shoreline or island inventory.
Small islands, disputed boundaries, dependencies, and narrow coastal features follow source coverage and may be absent or generalized.
All source Polygon/MultiPolygon parts and holes are retained; this build performs no runtime simplification.
Coordinate rounding to five decimal places is deterministic and does not promise survey-grade boundaries.
